title: MAAT KA2 Scorecard Contract
description: Self-validation scorecard attached to every research-grade archivist record. Threshold (pass_at) and RBL halt rule (halt_flags) are constitutional and live here, not in prompt text. Threshold changes are a sacred-layer change and require governed promotion.

passed.description: True when total >= pass_at AND halt_flags < 3.

halt_flags.description: Count of RBL indicators. >=3 triggers HALT regardless of numeric total.

correction_notes.description: Required when passed is false; names which axis failed and why.
